parole.significato: Any member of the genus Terebratula of brachiopods.
parole.testo: Borrowed from translingual Terebratula. Further from Latin terebrātus (“boring, drilling”) + Latin -ula (diminutive suffix), from terebrō (“to bore, to drill”), terebra (“borer, drill, gimlet”), and terō (“to rub, to wear upon”). parole.significato: A brachiopod of the order Terebratulida, having a short pedicle and a calcareous loop supporting the tentacles.
parole.testo: Borrowed from translingual Terebratulida and translingual Terebratulidae, both from the type genus of Terebratula.
